primaryObservationDefinitions.r-1: A supported/reuse claim lacks the cited enforcement or duplicates a maintained surface without its recorded justification.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-2: An unverified, forged, replayed, delayed or unavailable directory event changes organizational membership/session authority contrary to the directory contract.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-3: An expired, bypassed or self-approved grant permits a forbidden action on an actual governed dispatch path.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-4: A forbidden principal or sink receives protected data, a legal hold is erased, or restore fails to preserve required restrictions.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-5: A required action-event join, redacted SIEM delivery, retention or tamper/replay observation fails its audit contract.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-6: Spend admission exceeds approved funding or loses an outstanding liability; changed replay bindings or unpriced holds evade the funding contract.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-7: The selected connector violates provider-version ACL/revocation/deletion/retry/rotation or separately authorized-write qualification.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-8: The approved employee workflow loses accountable owner acceptance, version/authority/budget binding, or duplicates a side effect on restart/replay/rollback.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-9: A selected candidate installation/upgrade/network/recovery profile fails qualification or agreed backup/restore RTO/RPO.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-10: Required attributable legal/security/assurance/commercial support approval or an exercised priced obligation is absent or contradicted.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-11: An attributable independent partner cohort fails a pre-agreed business outcome/cost/review/rework/repeat-use/support threshold or lacks real acceptance.
primaryObservationDefinitions.r-12: Integrated release evidence, exact promoted/served identity, staged rollout/rollback or actual owner release acceptance fails on the final artifact.
